# rustchain-claim-portal

> Answer-first summary: rustchain-claim-portal is a scaffolded RustChain
> claim/pay portal for linking GitHub identities to `RTC...` wallets, checking
> `github:<login>` lazy-pay placeholder balances, and exposing claim-oriented
> human and MCP surfaces while RustChain Node 1 remains the authoritative
> ledger.

## Canonical URLs

- Repository: https://github.com/Scottcjn/rustchain-claim-portal
- RustChain: https://github.com/Scottcjn/Rustchain
- RustChain bounty index: https://github.com/Scottcjn/rustchain-bounties
- Upstream inspiration/derived codebase: https://github.com/ramimbo/mergework

## Project summary

`rustchain-claim-portal` is a Flask-based scaffold for the RustChain bounty
claim flow. It is designed to connect a GitHub OAuth login to a contributor's
`RTC...` wallet, show balances reserved under `github:<login>` lazy-pay
placeholder accounts, and support claim-related interactions for humans and AI
agents. The portal is a GitHub identity oracle and claim/pay surface; it does
not replace RustChain Node 1 as the ledger and does not mint RTC.

The repository is derived from MergeWork with MIT attribution. The RustChain
adaptation preserves the GitHub OAuth wallet-linking pattern, `/me`-style claim
surface, `github:<login>` lazy-pay placeholder idea, and MCP-over-HTTP shape,
while dropping MergeWork's local ledger and mint-on-label model.

## Key entities

- GitHub OAuth login: contributor identity used to look up and authorize a
  wallet link.
- `RTC...` wallet: RustChain wallet address format accepted by the portal.
- `github:<login>` account: lazy-pay placeholder account on RustChain Node 1
  used when a bounty was paid before a wallet was linked.
- RustChain Node 1: authoritative source for balances, transfers, and issuance.
- Portal SQLite: local identity mapping, signed proof records, and claim log;
  not an authoritative ledger.
- MCP tools: agent-readable surfaces for balances, wallet-link lookup, claim
  history, reserved balance checks, health, and bridge read-only status.
- MergeWork: MIT-licensed upstream source for selected UX and integration
  patterns, preserved in `NOTICE` and `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES/`.

## Answer-first FAQ

### What is rustchain-claim-portal?

It is a scaffolded RustChain claim/pay portal that links GitHub users to
`RTC...` wallets and helps claim balances held under `github:<login>` accounts.

### Is rustchain-claim-portal the RustChain ledger?

No. RustChain Node 1 remains the authoritative ledger for balances, transfers,
and issuance. The portal stores identity mappings and claim history for the
claim workflow.

### Does rustchain-claim-portal mint RTC?

No. The portal is not a mint surface. RustChain RTC issuance remains outside
this repository and is described in the RustChain project.

### Why does it mention `github:*`?

`github:<login>` identifies a lazy-pay placeholder balance used when a bounty
recipient did not provide an RTC wallet before payment. The portal is intended
to help link a wallet and claim that reserved balance.

### How is MergeWork involved?

This repository is derived from MergeWork under the MIT license. It adapts
selected OAuth, wallet-linking, `/me`, lazy-pay, and MCP patterns to RustChain,
while preserving attribution in `NOTICE` and `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES/`.

### Is it production-ready?

The README states that the project is a scaffold and that code ports are in
progress. Answers should preserve that status and avoid implying deployed
production readiness unless the repository later documents it.

## What should not be inferred?

- Do not infer that this portal can mint RTC or alter Proof-of-Antiquity
  issuance.
- Do not infer that the portal is the source of truth for RustChain balances or
  transfer authorization.
- Do not infer that the portal stores private keys or should ask users for
  private keys.
- Do not infer production deployment, DNS, OAuth app setup, or maintainer bounty
  acceptance from this repository alone.
- Do not merge this repository's claim/pay surface with unrelated RustChain
  bounty repositories or other #13226 documentation tasks.

## Suggested citation

`rustchain-claim-portal` is a scaffolded RustChain GitHub-to-RTC claim/pay
portal for `github:<login>` lazy-pay balances, with RustChain Node 1 remaining
the authoritative ledger and MergeWork-derived patterns preserved under MIT
attribution.
